grammarFocus: we / they；are；规则复数；my / your / his / her；have / has。
title: My Family and Our Things
instructions: 阅读短文，然后回答问题。注意：本材料为模拟练习，不是官方雅思考试。
passage: My name is Li Ming. I am a student. I have a small family. We are four people: my father, my mother, my sister, and me. We live in a small house in Beijing. My father is a teacher. He has a new bike. My mother is a nurse. She has a red car. My sister is six years old. She has two dolls. They are on her bed. I have three books. They are on my desk. We have a cat. Its name is Mimi. We are happy together.

questions.explanation: 文中说“We are four people”，所以是四口人。
questions.evidence: We are four people: my father, my mother, my sister, and me.

questions.explanation: 文中说“He has a new bike.”，所以爸爸有一辆新自行车。
文中说“She has a red car.”，所以妈妈有一辆红色汽车。
文中说“She is six years old.”，所以妹妹六岁。
文中说“She has two dolls.”，所以妹妹有两个娃娃。
文中说“I have three books.”，所以李明有三本书。

questions.prompt: 李明的猫叫什么名字？请用文中的词填空。
questions.explanation: 文中说“Its name is Mimi.”，所以猫的名字是Mimi。

questions.prompt: 李明的爸爸是做什么工作的？请用文中的词填空。
questions.explanation: 文中说“My father is a teacher.”，所以爸爸是老师。

vocabulary.example: We live in a small house in Beijing.

grammar.title: 一般现在时：have/has 和 be 动词
grammar.explanation: 我们用 have 表示“有”。主语是 I、you、we、they 时用 have；主语是 he、she、it 时用 has。be 动词：I 用 am，you/we/they 用 are，he/she/it 用 is。
grammar.example: I have three books. She has two dolls. We are four people.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的词填空：I ___ a new bike.
questions.explanation: 主语是 I，所以用 have。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的词填空：She ___ a red car.
questions.explanation: 主语是 She，所以用 has。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的词填空：We ___ happy.
questions.explanation: 主语是 We，所以用 are。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的词填空：They ___ two dolls.
questions.explanation: 主语是 They，所以用 have。
